messages:
liz: FYI opened PR 489 to tidy up console/observability docs. found three problems during local preview: 1) dashboard cost widget uses `per_token_cost_usd`, elsewhere we use `token_cost_usd`; 2) the tracing page is missing a Go tracehook example; 3) playground embed for trace preview returns 404 in staging. can we split work?
aj: thanks. i can standardize the metric name. prefer `token_cost_usd` for consistency. i'll grep the repo and push a rename commit + a docs-lint rule.
sam_k: i'll run the site link-checker against staging and prod to see if the iframe route is actually registered. if it's 404 in prod, might be a deploy or route rename.
maria: i'll take the Go snippet. want minimal usage only: show creating a TraceHook, attaching ctx, and tagging cost/latency. one small example, 6-8 lines.
liz: yes, keep it tiny. we already have JS and Python in other threads; add Go to make SDK parity clear. include a one-line comment about units (cost = USD float, latency = ms int).
maria: draft: ```go
import "github.com/redwood/trace"

hook := trace.NewHook("console-ui")
hook.AttachContext(map[string]string{"trace_id": traceID})
hook.SetTag("token_cost_usd", 0.0034)
hook.SetTag("latency_ms", 120)
```
aj: looks good. i'll also add a docs-linter check for `per_token_cost_usd` -> `token_cost_usd` and a unit note check for `latency_ms` vs `latency_s`.
infra-bot: docs-link-check started for PR 489. found 404 at /playground/trace-preview (expected 200). creating infra-ticket 312 for missing route.
sam_k: confirmed. staging and prod both 404. opening infra#312 as well with logs.
liz: ok plan: aj renames fields + linter, maria adds Go snippet and a small sentence about units, sam_k follows infra ticket and adds a fallback note in the docs (if embed missing show static GIF). aim to merge once infra confirms route or we add fallback. target: tomorrow noon. :rocket:
aj: will scope linter to the docs-lint repo only, tiny regex replace + unit test. pushing WIP.
maria: pushing WIP Go snippet in ~15m, i'll also add a one-line link to SDK reference for Go tracehook.
docs-bot: PR 489 opened by liz  reviewers: @aj @maria. CI: docs-link-check pending; docs-lint pending.
infra-bot: infra#312 created. assigned to @dave-infra. note: route name changed in router rewrite PR 798; potential regression.
sam_k: adding a quick smoke fallback: if iframe 404, render `playground/trace-preview-static.png` in docs so customers at least see an image. i'll add that in the PR as a temporary guard.
liz: love the fallback plan. can we also add a one-line migration note in changelog about the metric rename to avoid breaking queries?
aj: yes i'll add a brief note in docs/console/CHANGELOG.md and the API migration guide.
maria: WIP commit pushed. kept the Go snippet minimal and added unit note.
infra-bot: dave-infra acknowledged infra#312 and will investigate router rewrite. ETA 4h.
docs-bot: docs-link-check  PR 489: after fallback image added, link-check shows 200 for docs page but iframe still 404 (expected). marking PR as blocked on infra#312.
liz: thanks all. i'll leave PR as blocked and update the PR description with infra ticket link and the fallback note. will reassign once infra confirms route or we change the embed URL. /end of thread
